content: WebAuthn PRF extension (WebAuthn L3) lets an RP request a deterministic 32-byte pseudo-random output tied to a credential+salt during an assertion ceremony, usable as symmetric key material; on real security keys it maps to CTAP2 hmac-secret. A software/virtual authenticator (like passkey-rs) can implement PRF itself since it controls the credential secret directly, without needing hardware hmac-secret support.
